title: Case archive knowledge sync
scope: Materialize archived Case summaries into durable local knowledge-sync artifacts while preserving NAS/DLQ archive finalization and user-visible sync status.

acceptance_criteria.description: The standalone CaseEngine default archive hook writes markdown and JSONL sync records instead of logging a knowledge-sync stub.
The production case_plugin archive hook composes CaseKnowledgeSync with archive_root set to data_dir / "case_archives" before or alongside NAS/DLQ archiving.
Knowledge sync failures are recorded or logged without crashing archive finalization; NAS/DLQ archive behavior still proceeds.
Sync records are append-only JSONL entries with case_id, status, archive_path, source_path, task_ids, deliverable_count, error, and created_at.
Archived Case markdown is materialized under data/case_archives/<case_id>.md and includes Case identity, client/session/platform metadata, tasks, deliverables, payload, and generated timestamp.
The /case sync-status <case_id> command exposes the latest sync status, archive path, source path, deliverable count, task count, created_at, and error when present.

Generated data/case_archives runtime outputs are ignored by git, and custom case IDs are sanitized into archive filenames that remain inside archive_root while preserving the original case_id in records.

non_goals: Do not import archived Case markdown into a vector database in this step.
Do not make NAS availability a prerequisite for user-facing Case archive completion.
Do not store runtime data or generated archive outputs in git.
